target: Conditional squared continuation-contrast prediction risk, averaged uniformly over all 16 R16 seeds and all 384 fixed task-state queries in each of 8 economic cells. The action pair is the frozen stage-3 NBO action versus the analytical reference, identical for every predictor. Predictions are finite deployed binary64 values.
margin_interpretation: Squared-utility resolution reference (1e-4)^2; a risk-difference sign is not a payoff gain of 1e-4.
seed_population: Every seed, dimension, query, task and calibration in the immutable R16 menu protocol; no omissions or substitutions.
raw_predictor: Sample-average continuation contrasts on a newly generated cached bank; nested 2,8,32 antithetic pairs. These are not the R16 Raw actor and not its payoff estimand.
independence: Condition on all old fits, selected action pairs and new Raw caches. Hash-separated NBO-R17 domains for cached-raw-before-audit and independent-risk-audit. One antithetic pair is one independent observation; queries and seeds use disjoint draws.
confirmation: All predictions, geometric bounds and a range-only precision planning receipt are durably written before the first audit draw in a cell. No sample-size adaptation, stage selection, favorable-cell selection or outcome-dependent margin.
missingness: Any missing model, seed, action, receipt or bank fails the complete-family report; no fitted policy or evidence is replaced by a favorable fallback.
family_account: The new 24-event family has simultaneous conditional coverage at least .99. The four inherited R16 families retain their .05 total failure allocation; a conjunction across both generations has union-bound coverage at least .94, not .95.
scope_exclusions: No attribution of the R16 Raw-actor payoff contrast to this new risk estimand
